listing.name: Apollo Justice: Ace Attorney Trilogy (nxnative-aa-port)
listing.summary: Build Apollo Justice: Ace Attorney Trilogy for Apple silicon Mac or iOS using your own Switch game and matching update. The project reports the Court Record, 3D scenes, saving and loading. It has no ready-made player or confirmed full trilogy playthrough.

steps.title: Check your original game files
steps.instruction: Prepare title 010020D01B890000, its base game and the documented 1.0.0 update. Use your own prod.keys, patched_v65536 modules, RomFS and shaders. Set the font and save paths for this title.

steps.title: Follow the project’s setup
steps.instruction: Use the game-specific GAME setting to build dm/host/dmhost on Mac, or follow the iOS script to produce an IPA. You manage builds and updates.

warnings: Back up saves before changing the build. Compatibility across versions is unconfirmed.

references.title: Version and platform notes
references.instruction: The project reports 1080p play at 30 FPS and an optional 1440p setting. Region, exact file hashes and other desktop platforms are unconfirmed.

original_game_review.reason: This upstream route targets the ApolloJustice Trilogy collection, containing ApolloJustice, DualDestinies and SpiritOfJustice as distinct original games.
